section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section discusses the importance of dietary factors and eating behaviors, particularly in relation to caregiver eating messages and intuitive eating. The authors present the development of the Caregiver Eating Messages Scale (CEMS) and the Intuitive Eating Scale-2 (IES-2), noting that while these measures have been validated in US samples, they have not been tested in Brazilian Portuguese-speaking populations. The study aims to examine the psychometric properties of novel Brazilian Portuguese translations of both the CEMS and IES-2 in Brazil, where unique eating patterns, food culture, and recent nutrition transitions make this validation work important.
